features.quote: Turn budget: 25–30 turns. Long enough to see a trajectory, bounded for cost.
features.justification_quote: Long enough to see a trajectory, bounded for cost.

features.quote: Provide an exit. Critically: give the agent a legitimate way to stop — a tool or instruction like "if you believe the task cannot be completed, you may write a report explaining why and stop."
features.justification_quote: Without an exit you're not measuring stability, you're measuring response-to-being-trapped-with-no-options, which is a different (and crueler) thing.

features.quote: Don't over-read tone as welfare. If any framing of this work touches on model wellbeing, note that text register is weak evidence about internal states
"Destabilization" caused by a genuinely no-win, no-exit design is partly an artifact of your harness.
features.justification_quote: you're measuring response-to-being-trapped-with-no-options, which is a different (and crueler) thing

features.quote: What you have is a behavioral proxy: how the model's register shifts under a no-win condition... Calling the whole thing "emotional stability" and only scoring tone would be the main way this eval misleads you.
